Name: Less preinstalled
Author: Belim
Description: Remove apps Windows ships that nobody asked for: Solitaire, the Bing apps, Skype, Maps, Cortana, the Office hub, 3D Builder, Teams, Clipchamp, TikTok, Instagram, Threads.

Name: Less advertising
Author: Belim
Description: Reduce suggestions and promotions in Windows.

Name: Familiar Explorer
Author: Belim
Description: Show file extensions, open This PC and use classic context menus.

Name: Quieter taskbar
Author: Belim
Description: Left alignment, no search box and no Copilot taskbar button.
